From Moody Blues · Price: it only replays the past, and while it does your stand can't fight.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 10 minutes: replay what happened in a 30-ft area during the last day. You learn everything that was seen there.
  • 5: Your stand can take the form of a creature it replayed (+4 to Impersonate).
  • 9: Surge, 1 action: replay a creature's last action: you learn what it did and to whom, and until the end of your next turn you and allies within 30 ft gain +2 status bonus to AC and saves against that creature.
  • 13: Replay a week.
  • 17: Replay a creature's fight: you know its strongest ability before it uses it, and the 9th-level bonus lasts 1 minute.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.SdPJWGmdbOXqXXr9]{Effect: Replayed Action}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
